name: text-row
title: Text Row
summary: A label and its value on one row, as in a summary or an invoice.
description: A label at the start and its value at the end: the rows of a summary, an invoice or a settings card. The workhorse of every card. The label wraps when it runs out of room; the value is never truncated and keeps tabular figures.

notes: Plain text. For a list of rows that reads as name/value pairs, wrap them in a <dl> at the page level.
